overall_goal: Clean dishes, tidy the sink area, and organize ingredients.

goals.description: Wash cutlery and load it into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person lathers and rinses spoons and a knife, then places them into the dishwasher's cutlery drawer.

goals.description: Rinse bowls and load them into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person empties and rinses two bowls under the tap before placing them in the lower drawer of the dishwasher.

goals.description: Rinse a glass and load it into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person rinses a glass under the tap and places it in the second drawer of the dishwasher.

goals.description: Wash a mug and a lid and place them on the drainer.
goals.rationale: The person lathers and rinses a mug and a thermal flask lid, then sets them on the drainer to dry.

goals.description: Wash plates and load them into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person lathers and rinses plates, then slides them into slots in the third drawer of the dishwasher.

goals.description: Load chopping boards into the dishwasher.
goals.rationale: The person picks up chopping boards from the countertop and fits them into the dishwasher drawer.

goals.description: Dispose of food waste from the countertop.
goals.rationale: The person gathers fallen carrot pieces from the countertop and throws them into the food waste bin.

goals.description: Wash a mug and a knife.
goals.rationale: The person rinses a mug and places it in the dishwasher, then lathers and rinses a knife and puts it on the drainer.

goals.description: Clean the sink and dispose of collected food waste.
goals.rationale: The person gathers food debris from the sink into the plug, empties it into the bin, and rinses the sink basin.

goals.description: Remove gloves and put away unused ingredients.
goals.rationale: The person takes off their washing gloves, places butter in the fridge, and returns a cocoa can to the cupboard.
